review_evidence: affine.v:10-23 defines Record t with x,y : FieldElement.t and from_encoded_point that checks curve equation y² = x³ + ax + b
projective.v:14-99 defines Record t with x,y,z : FieldElement.t and implements complete Jacobian coordinate formulas for double, add, mul via double-and-add, and lincomb
summary: Both files contain substantial formal mathematical content related to P256 elliptic curve operations. affine.v defines AffinePoint record and from_encoded_point for decoding/validating curve points. projective.v defines ProjectivePoint record with Jacobian coordinates and implements core group operations: IDENTITY, is_identity, from_affine, to_affine, double, add, mul (scalar multiplication), and lincomb. These are executable formal specifications of cryptographic primitives, not import aggregators or boilerplate.
